notes.title: Happy Chinese New Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32626098/a25401eac155a6b1357ae4f76f3bab66696cec1c.png[/img]

Dear Chinese players!

I fell in love with Chinese culture as soon as I watched an old (1961) animated movie about Sun Wukong "Havoc in Heaven" on Soviet TV, it was the mid 1980s and I was 6-7 years old. Hong Kong's 80-90s movies and martial arts practicing cemented that love, and while I was growing up I tried to learn more about your country's story, religion and philosophy.

I finally visited China for the very first time in 2023 (I was in Shanghai) and since I was amazed with the country I took my family on another trip soon after that and we've been in Beijing and Hong Kong. Hong Kong was good, but was a little too western, but both Shanghai and Beijing were great. Clean streets, many trees, people are friendly and helpful, city colors, I really was impressed.

I'm really proud that more than 70% of the players of my games are Chinese people.

I want to wish all the best to you and your families in the New Year! And thank you very much for supporting my games!

notes.title: New update is coming!
notes.content:
Hello, fellas!

Maybe you know that I'm working on my hobby project about school delinquents now. We almost finished with all background concepts and now I'm working on dialogues, battle mechanics and game structure. It's a lot of work, so I'm not sure when the game will be ready.

As for animations, we took animations from my last game Fading Afternoon, Ueda M. redesigned it for school uniform and my dad added shadows. And since FA used animations from Ringo, now I basically have updated Ringo animations. And some new ones.

I was thinking of making a DLC or even remaster the whole game, but now I decided to just update it for free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32626098/00c3ec26674000934d21f4a3575624ce8183d569.png[/img]

I'm not sure how much content I'll add but my current list is this:

1. Updated sprites for characters
2. New skills for Mechanic (his original skills all sucked)
3. Bicycles
4. New street with bicycle store and fish store
5. Fishing mini-game from FA
6. Local co-op
7. Lowering screen size from 250x140 to 240x135 so the game will look cleaner in full screen (I don't know why I made 250x140... all fonts looks horrible in full screen)
8. Jumping will be removed
9. Updated battle mechanics (I think that battle system could be better, compared to FA and my current project it's not that fun, so I want to update it)
10. Skippable cutscenes and dialogues (as I made it in FA)
11. Some new battle animations (I already made 1 brand new kick that wasn't even in FA, and I want to add some damaging animations from FA and maybe new throw skill for Judo class)
12. Free roam mode
13. Maybe something more...

I think that I'll start updating the game in a couple of weeks, so the first update will be ready by New Year. I won't add all this content in one patch, so it'll be added gradually.

Stay tuned, and thank you very much for your support and continuous interest in the game!

P.S.

Original version will stay available on a different branch.

notes.title: The game was ported to GMS 2.3
notes.content:
Hello!

Some windows 11 users had problems with the game (a black screen at start, you can overcome this by entering window mode with F4 though). 

I couldn't fix it cause GM 1.4 (game engine I used for developing the game) ceased to work. YoYoGames stopped supporting it. So I had to port the game to GMS 2.3 to fix that problem.

New engine could bring new bugs, so please report them, I'll try to find and fix them.

You can play the old version via the "old_version" branch any time.

The game is the same for now, but I plan to make a DLC with local co-op in the nearest future (I'll try to make online co-op as well, but it's a hard task). Not sure about adding more content, but it's possible as well.

Thank you very much for your continuous support of the game!

notes.title: Switch release!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32626098/38dbeb13e8ba248a33892362d044dd7a21b847ed.jpg[/img]

1) Players who played the game, made comments, wrote reviews so the game didn't sunk to the Steam's bottom and got some coverage in media where @CATCLANOYABUN came across it.

2) [url=https://twitter.com/CATCLANOYABUN]@CATCLANOYABUN[/url] liked it and proposed to CEO of [url=https://twitter.com/CIRCLE_Ent]CIRCLE Ent.[/url], a company she works on as a translator, for importing to Switch.

notes.title: 汉化更新公告
notes.content:
大家好，

在经过一段时间的校对和润色后，全新的官方中文版本已经上线。当然，这并不意味着我们的工作已经结束：由于本游戏的代码结构，事实上本地化工作中存在许多障碍。制作者需要手动导出所有的文本，并在必要的时候手动修改变动了的条目，而批量替换也可能导致一些意料之外的错误和疏漏。此外，界面中的一些文本也因为字体大小所限而无法以中文来显示。我们将继续协助制作者及时订正和改进可能出现的一些错误，同时也希望玩家们可以在发现错误时在社区向我们汇报，帮助我们更早地完善《石河倫吾的朋友们》的中文版。

在此再次感谢制作者yeo的倾力开发与协助，如果没有他的努力，不可能有这一次的更新。事实上就在今天提交译文的过程中，我们还修正和增补了许多未汉化的内容。

祝大家能更好地体验游戏的乐趣！如果发现有错译、漏译的地方，请务必指出，我们会第一时间予以修正。

——Indienova团队于6月29日

Indienova校对组成员：craft，AKK，inferiortiy，SisseL，两鱼，piro，萌萌的菠萝包，west，谜之声

Hello guys! Chinese and Japanese localization campaigns launched! I hope to deliver them in three weeks!

And thank you for all your reviews on the game! I'm very touched by them!

notes.title: Please accept my apologies
notes.content:
Hello, guys.

First of all, please accept my apologies for game bugs and crashes. And I'd like to shed some light on it.

All these years I made my games with Gammaker 8.0 version which I liked and knew quite well. But some time ago I lost my license cause the rain broke through the window and killed the computer. I know that's sounds funny but I'm not just making it up )

I still had 2 more license activation so I contacted yoyogames to discover that they don't support 8.0 anymore and have license base only for 8.1. And of course you can't buy 8.1 anymore since there's Studio.

Ok. I started to look after 8.1 license (proof: https://forums.tigsource.com/index.php?topic=60419) and at last my friend gave me his key. I calmed down and continued development.

But a month before release (this April) it striked me that I can't compile the game with his key because it'll technically and legally makes my friend a co-author. 

So I imported to GMS 1.4 (which license bought earlier, it doesn't sell now also). 

And though GMS resembles GM 8.0 quite a lot it is a different platform with its own details and things you need to know through experience. So all testing and fine-tuning I did all these years of development has gone. 

GMS has some different logic here and there, so I'm learning it hard way.

And I couldn't afford another months of testing it even if I should so I released the game as it is.

So I'm really sorry for all those bugs (major and minor) that ruined your joy. I'm working on them!

And I want to thank the players who supported me these days! It was so unexpected and really moved me!

Thank you very much!
